node.title: XR split-pencil dual trades have no rank one and localized rank two
node.statement: Let Lambda be a nonzero dual trade with distinct slopes and block intersection cap four. Rank one is impossible: dual RS_2 slope distance forces at least three proportional block rows, while dual GRS_4 distance gives them a common support of size at least five. At rank two there are at least four projectively distinct block rows; disjointness of their noncommon zero sets on the row-code line gives active coordinate support R<=floor(tm/(t-1))<=floor(4m/3). The official P-A caps are 12/12/9 and P-B one-loop caps are 13/13/10. This is a bounded-chart localization, not a payment.
